Two finals, play by play

Source: R/data.R
pbp_games.Rd

Every event of the 2025 NBA Finals Game 7 (Oklahoma City 103, Indiana 91) and the 2025 EuroLeague final, in the ggbasket play-by-play layout (see pbp), with the players on court.

Usage

pbp_games

Format

A tibble, one row per event; columns as described in pbp.

Source

NBA: ESPN play-by-play via hoopR. EuroLeague: official live API (PlayByPlay and Points). Built by data-raw/make_pbp.R.
